status: NOT_RUN; kernel provider implementation and integration verification are required
scope: Common existing interface checking only; not a new public receiver, not a Boolean ABI for satisfies, not a regex engine or a second validator.
service_payload_profile: Empty () for these internal service exits; implicit/system diagnostics are not caught or reclassified as false.

cases.title: Ready Pattern interface
cases.setup: Use a candidate with the full Pattern positional contract; its body increments a fixture counter.

cases.title: Proved non-Pattern
cases.setup: Use an initialized int record and an ordinary noncallable Structure as separate candidates.

cases.title: Names and full compatible requirements
cases.setup: Use a callable whose formal labels differ and whose full input/result requirements are admitted by the same positional-signature checker. Include a permitted type relation that is not raw-code equality.
cases.action: Compare the bridge observation with the actual existing interface-check result in the same Message type/conversion context.

cases.title: Unknown is not false
cases.setup: Supply an instrumented checker situation where a required computed path cannot be established without execution. The existing checker must classify it unresolved, not incompatible.
cases.action: Probe and attempt the ordinary | dispatch path.
cases.expected: FxKernelFailure() service outcome; no return 0, numeric fallback, literal normalization or candidate execution.

cases.title: Invalid requirement
cases.setup: Pass an invalid interned type code or malformed requirement according to the provider admission profile.
cases.expected: FxTypeToken(); no conversion to a false predicate result.

cases.title: Copied unbounded configuration
cases.setup: Construct an ordinary grouped copy of unbounded under the common graph-copy map; retain its full structural fields and qualifiers.
cases.action: Probe the original and copied configuration against RxUnbounded; construct a repetition using the copy.

cases.title: Finite repetition bound
cases.setup: Use an ordinary finite nonnegative int maximum and a negative maximum in separate cases.
cases.action: Probe maximum against RxUnbounded, then use the existing finite-bound branch.

expected.nonnegative_maximum: ordinary int reception and bound checks retained

cases.title: Replacement text and compatible callback
cases.setup: Use literal char[] text and a callable admitted by RxReplacement, each with the relevant ordinary requirement.
cases.action: Construct replacement and then run a search with zero matches and with two selected matches.

cases.title: Positive interface observation is not value admission
cases.setup: Use a declared compatible converter or analytical admission test whose actual execution would fail or increment a counter.
cases.action: First inspect the interface, then perform one ordinary real reception in a separate step.

expected.real_reception: retains the original conversion/test failure and effect timing; probe does not bypass it

cases.title: Numeric | remains its existing operation
cases.setup: Provide only numeric or admitted existing non-Pattern Array operands, including zero; none satisfies Pattern.
cases.action: Run the unchanged | entry through its existing dispatch and compare with the original numeric/Array contract.

cases.title: One Pattern selects ordinary Pattern admission
cases.setup: Provide a ready Pattern and literal text; separately provide a Pattern and a number that is inadmissible as Pattern/text.

expected.valid_case: ordered choice, with no trial matcher call during construction
expected.invalid_case: ordinary admission failure, not numeric fallback or mismatch

cases.title: No added analysis effects or cache
cases.setup: Use defaults, computed fields and supplied callbacks with observable counters; repeat successful probes in the same legitimate type context.
cases.action: Read the interface multiple times without real consumption.

cases.title: Interpreter/native agreement
cases.setup: Run all definitive positive/negative cases through interpreted caller/interpreted provider, interpreted/native, native/interpreted and native/native integration configurations.
cases.action: Inspect the same source candidates and requirements without implicit compilation.

required_evidence: Attach real kernel revision, binding code for the existing checker, explicit no-effect counters, positive/negative/unknown observations and the four dispatch configurations. Source presence, a mock predicate or a standalone host-language reconstruction is not this evidence.
